BYD's Luxury Brand Denza Set to Enter India with D9 Electric MPV Launch Planned for Late 2026

29 Oct 2026, 02:22 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysBYD is preparing to introduce its luxury sub-brand, Denza, to the Indian automotive market. Functioning similarly to how Lexus operates under Toyota, Denza focuses on high-end vehicles. Denza's Entry into the Indian Market

BYD is preparing to introduce its luxury sub-brand, Denza, to the Indian automotive market. Functioning similarly to how Lexus operates under Toyota, Denza focuses on high-end vehicles. The brand's first offering for India is scheduled to be unveiled on November 13, 2026, marking the introduction of the Denza D9 MPV.

Industry reports indicate that the D9 will arrive as an imported model. Furthermore, plans suggest the vehicle may be retailed through a distinct dealership network separate from standard BYD showrooms.

Specifications and Features

Market expectations point toward the introduction of the all-electric variant of the D9 initially, with a plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) version anticipated at a later date. The electric MPV boasts a claimed driving range of approximately 600 kilometers on a single charge.

Dimensionally, the Denza D9 is a large vehicle. It measures 5,250 mm in length, 1,960 mm in width, and 1,920 mm in height, supported by a wheelbase exceeding three meters. The cabin features a 2+2+3 seating layout, with primary emphasis placed on the second row. Second-row occupants receive individual seats equipped with ventilation, built-in massage functions, and legrests. Additional cabin amenities include soft-close doors, zero-gravity seats, and an integrated refrigerator equipped with a hotbox.

Positioning and Market Context

Positioning for the Denza D9 places it in the luxury MPV segment, where it is expected to compete against models like the MG M9 and the Toyota Vellfire. Analysts note a notable price gap between the MG M9 and the Toyota Vellfire. The Denza D9 is projected to slot into this gap, likely carrying an expected price tag under Rs 1 crore while positioned above the MG M9, catering to a growing domestic demand for spacious luxury people-movers.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers interested in tracking the official rollout of the Denza brand can review verified updates directly through the original reporting published on ABP Live (https://news.abplive.com/auto/denza-d9-mpv-india-launch-soon-600km-range-luxury-features-but-what-about-price-1872850)

Confirmed Facts vs. Unknowns

  • Confirmed: The unveiling date is set for November 13, 2026; the vehicle will be imported; the electric version targets a ~600km range; dimensions include a 5,250 mm length and 3m+ wheelbase.
  • Unknown/Unconfirmed: Exact final retail pricing, specific dealership locations, and the precise timeline for the plug-in hybrid variant's arrival remain unconfirmed by final commercial announcements.
